author_raw.selection: one fixed run; not upstream ten runs with minimum-W1 selection
author_raw.input: identical full raw feature rows across methods; no scaling, PCA preprocessing or subset

evaluation_kmeans.clusters: number of actual classes, post-fit only

adaptations: Standalone original call-site adapter invokes unchanged author model/loss/PH, CPU single thread; no ParaView, CGAL or OpenMP.
Compatibility includes, old Boost feature macro and stale no-CGAL type alias; author implementation not replaced.
Final full-cloud encode remains train mode with batch statistics.
One authorized import-only synthetic UMAP preflight repair blocks optional TensorFlow after protobuf incompatibility; no real fit retried.

digits_matched.split: default_rng(0).permutation(1797), first 1400 fit, remainder held out
digits_matched.preprocessing: raw64 pixels; no standardization or fit-to-heldout preprocessing
digits_matched.neighbor_support: Identical 15 nonself fit neighbors plus UMAP self column; genuine prepared NNDescent31 query index. Retained fit IDs verified.
digits_matched.not_matched: Native fuzzy weights, kernel, edge scheduling and query transform remain method-specific. Equal epochs do not imply equal exposures.
digits_matched.pca: full-SVD2 fitted on fit features only
digits_matched.labels: Only post-fit scores and plot colors; not reducer objectives, graphs, stopping or selection. Loader may return label metadata earlier.
digits_matched.class_components: Restrict the full-cohort symmetrized Euclidean k15 graph to each actual class; never recompute neighbors within class.
digits_matched.query_scope: Heldout397 clusters use query-only geometry; combined1797 is inductive, not an all1797 fit.

metrics.neighbors: Exact full-cohort Euclidean kNN overlap, trustworthiness and continuity; k15 unless otherwise stated.
metrics.distance_stress: Least-squares global all-pair source-distance scaling for stress only; no figure rescaling.
metrics.ari: Post-fit KMeans partition versus actual class labels; not a training objective, classifier or proof of natural clusters.
metrics.critical_edge_h1: Complete Euclidean VR H1 over F2; normalized counts divide each cloud by its own median pair distance. Not author W1 or generator identity.
metrics.tail_h1: Complete raw Euclidean VR H1; target uses one least-squares all-pair source-distance scalar, not target median or diagram-fitted scale.
metrics.author_raw_h1: Complete Euclidean VR H1/F2; each source/target divided by its own median positive pair distance. Counts at lifetime thresholds0.1/0.25/0.5 describe normalized shape, not raw scale or source-generator correspondence.

protocol.name: multiscale log-distance continuation
protocol.level_weight: equal mass per level including local and MST
protocol.target: source Euclidean distance / median source15 distance
protocol.initial: current GraphEmbedding centered / median target source15-edge length
protocol.selection: single fixed run per cohort, no retries/tuning

candidate_outcomes.interpretation: Structural loss falls but replacing local attraction/repulsion by sparse log-distance stress produces false neighbors and severe folding/mixing. Low selected-distance loss is not a topology or local-rank certificate.

candidate_outcomes.seed_metadata_note: Actual confirmation seeds are 1 and 2. One of four paired fit-ARI changes is positive; no seed4 run is registered.
candidate_outcomes.mechanism: Attractive potential log(1+r^2) for r<=1, log(2)+r-1 above 1; threshold is existing kernel unit, not tuned. Original graph, initialization per seed, epochs300, negatives5, schedule and mapper retained.
limitations: Schedule identity audited, but floating reassociation differs below the join and prototype omits production event-budget abort checks; not a bitwise single-expression isolation.
Silhouette, k15 overlap and trustworthiness decrease in all four new-seed fit pairs; continuity improves.
Source-aligned relative Betti L1 worsens in all four new-seed pairs. Exact source-class preservation is not established.
Two seeds and related cohorts are not four independent datasets; no significance or general clustering-win claim.
candidate_outcomes.raw_transfer_note: All four reconstructed original layouts reproduce old controls bitwise. Mixed transfers do not rescue failed Digits confirmation or certify H1 preservation.

fashion_transfer.protocol: TRAIN-only existing fit-only PCA features and frozen source graph/initialization; no official TEST. 300 epochs, 5 negatives. KMeans10 n_init10 seed0 all50000; overlap on fixed512 queries against all50000; silhouette on fixed2048 points, RNG943.
fashion_transfer.interpretation: ARI rises slightly, but NMI, sampled silhouette and sampled overlap decline versus original. Not an all-metric gain and not a heldout result.

protocol.initialization: same saved GraphEmbedding, centered then once globally least-squares scaled against all source pairs
protocol.objective: Equal-weight sum of per-group mean squared edge-distance errors, preserving multiplicities; source distances are targets for all groups.
protocol.source_only: Fixed author source MST, birth, death, strict-cascade groups.
protocol.adaptive_mst: Fixed source groups plus target SciPy MST refreshed each round.
protocol.adaptive_full: Adaptive MST plus author-oracle target birth/death groups refreshed each round; no target cascade.
protocol.selection: last finite iterate; no PH-based iterate selection, retuning or real fit retry
protocol.oracle_role: Unchanged author PairCellsWithOracle for constraints; own direct-coordinate solver is not an independent TopoAE++ implementation.

failures: COIL20-1 adaptive_full target oracle times out before zero-based round14; last14-round iterate is partial/failed, not a successful result.
Initial registration filename collision and macOS RLIMIT_AS preflight refusal retained; authorized pre-data portability rebuild, no data-fit retry.
Post-export oracle probes passed17/19: coincident points rejected for invalid MST; exact square timed out. No fallback or jitter.
No hard RSS/address-space cap on macOS; wall/CPU bounds do not imply total memory guarantee.
candidate_outcomes.interpretation: K4 adaptive_full matches three bars at normalized lifetime0.25 but loses neighborhoods and fails exact same-Gamma gate. Source-only low stress and adaptive MST bar counts are not preservation certificates.

same_cycle_gate.units: Original raw-source float64 Euclidean; closed <= thresholds, no target rescaling during gate
same_cycle_gate.source_selection: Three longest finite source H1 bars propose common interior interval; source MST fundamental cycles and cochain pairing select three independent Gamma chains. Same indexed chains transported unchanged.
same_cycle_gate.limitation: This strict fixed-representative, fixed-interval, fixed-scale single-seed contract also rejects the actual author baseline. It does not claim paper failure, impossibility under other representatives/scales, or failure of all topology-preserving methods. Endpoint-only rank is diagnostic, never relaxed acceptance.

Matched seed0 exact15 nonself support, 300 epochs and five negatives; UMAP has self column and native weights/kernel/scheduler. FIT1400 row is not interchangeable with a separate all1797 fit. Labels are actual classes and only post-fit diagnostics; KMeans10 seed0 n_init20.

limitations: Frozen historical settings and single raw-author seed; unequal compute. No state-of-the-art, speed, general clustering or untouched-paper reproduction claim.
Digits author-adapter and 3Clusters timeouts are resource-limited missing results, not proof of method incapability.
The raw-author UMAP protocol (15, automatic epochs) differs from the matched Digits UMAP protocol (16 including self, 300 epochs); do not pool their ARI results.
Class1 fragmentation is shared by Graph and matched UMAP; source bottlenecks, initialization and local-objective amplification are evidence, not semantic ground truth or a uniquely isolated cause.
All registered critical-edge arms and both multiscale cohorts are included, including optimizer caps and oracle timeout; candidates are not defaults.
Raster geometry alone does not certify H1 correspondence; bar counts, low stress and endpoint-only rank do not replace the same-cycle gate.
Optional MoCap and SingleCell metadata were inspected but runs were not scheduled; neither is an omitted failed fit.
